description: Put a player-owned object up for async sale at a price (or delist). Prerequisite: you are the owner of the target object (VMTSOObjectState.OwnerID == you; handler-side gate). Object must not be in use. Pass new_price >= 0 to list at that price, new_price = -1 to delist. Effect: the object flags toggle ForSale on the lot; visitors see it with a 'Buy' pie-menu interaction. Cost: none while listed; when a visitor buys, they pay new_price and you receive it via GlobalLink.PurchaseFromOwner. Wire: VMNetAsyncPriceCmd on the lot Aries socket.
call_signatures: cf $CF list-object-for-sale --target_object_persist_id <pid> --new_price <price>                      # object-owner; price >= 0 to list, -1 to delist
common_mistakes: new_price missing → ok:false; pass -1 explicitly to delist, or >= 0 to list at that price.
perception_hints: Your balance (can you afford the object?): perception.balance
Am I the owner? perception.lot.owner_is_me — owner-only ops refuse otherwise
Free tile to place on: inspect perception.nearby_objects[] to find unoccupied tiles; positions are in tile coords, multiply by 16 for subtile x/y
refuse_conditions: caller is not the object owner → ok:false
